features.description: Regen-on-build, cache-only: the dashboard build self-heals a missing/stale architecture map into the dashboard cache (never the tracked repo's working tree), so the Architecture tab reflects current truth without a human 'run regen' card.
features.acceptance: Missing map → regenerated into out_dir cache + tracked repo untouched + view-state has a map; fresh map (fingerprint match) → no regen; unreadable repo → build does not raise. Full architecture/build/view-state suite green (147).

features.description: Watch architecture.json: add each project's snapshot to the serve's watched sources so a hook-commit or manual regen retriggers the serve rebuild live (today the watcher only fires on plan files).
features.acceptance: Editing a tracked project's docs/architecture/architecture.json while serve --watch is running retriggers a rebuild and the Architecture tab reflects the change without a restart.

features.description: Auto-install the pre-commit architecture hook on `projects add` (with a --no-hooks opt-out) so every tracked repo auto-regens + stages the committed map on commit — keeping the committed copy fresh between dashboard builds.
features.acceptance: `dontpanic projects add <name> <path>` installs the chained pre-commit hook (preserving any prior hook); --no-hooks skips it; a commit touching an architecture-relevant file regenerates + stages docs/architecture/architecture.json.
